responsibility: Implements the interprocedural identical code folding pass for functions and readonly variables. It builds semantic items from symtab nodes, hashes them, forms and refines congruence classes using references and deep equality, performs value-numbering-style class reduction, merges equivalent symbols by redirecting calls or creating aliases/thunks, and fixes dependent analyses such as points-to information after variable merging. This is the main pass driver and whole-symbol equivalence manager, distinct from the lower-level GIMPLE comparator in ipa-icf-gimple.cc.
same_name_distinction: Drives the whole IPA identical code folding pass: builds semantic items and congruence classes, reads/writes summaries, refines equivalence classes, merges symbols, and fixes dependent analysis state. Unlike gcc/ipa-icf.h, it is the pass implementation and orchestration rather than the declaration of the optimizer’s core classes and data structures.
